questions.solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Was** should be used here instead of **were**.
 
• **Was** is the** first and third-person singular past tense **of the verb **to be**, while **were** is the **second-person singular past and plural past** of the verb **to be**.
 
• **Out new house** is **singular** and therefore, the use of **was** is more appropriate here. 
 
• Thus, the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence is** option 1**.
